hotspots.speaker: santa
hotspots.text: Shh. The moon is the only one who knows which house I visit first. And she never tells.

hotspots.label: The candy canes
hotspots.speaker: elf
hotspots.text: Follow the candy canes! They always lead somewhere sweet. Usually straight to the bakery.

hotspots.label: Say hello to the snowman
hotspots.speaker: elf
hotspots.text: Bless you! He sneezes every time somebody says hello. Hold on to your hat!

hotspots.label: Santa Claus
hotspots.speaker: santa
hotspots.text: Ho ho ho! You made it just in time. Pull up a chair by the fire. I'm checking my list, and I'm rather sure your name is on it.

hotspots.label: The sleepy cat
hotspots.speaker: santa
hotspots.text: Mittens! Those were for the reindeer! Oh, very well. Just the one.

hotspots.label: Santa's list
hotspots.speaker: santa
hotspots.text: Let me see now. Amelia, a red bicycle. Theo, a telescope for the stars. And you, my friend. Hmm, I think you'll like what's under the tree.
